outcomeNote: mishna rulings; R' Yehuda's 'אף' may be an addition rather than a dispute

segments.he: לֹא יַעֲמוֹד אָדָם בִּרְשׁוּת הַיָּחִיד וְיַשְׁתִּין בִּרְשׁוּת הָרַבִּים, בִּרְשׁוּת הָרַבִּים וְיַשְׁתִּין בִּרְשׁוּת הַיָּחִיד, וְכֵן לֹא יָרוֹק.
segments.en: However, «a person» may «not stand in a private domain and urinate into a public domain,» nor may one stand «in a public domain and urinate into a private domain. And likewise, one» may «not spit» in such a manner that the spittle passes from a private domain to a public domain or vice versa.

segments.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: אַף מִשֶּׁנִּתְלַשׁ רוּקּוֹ בְּפִיו, לֹא יְהַלֵּךְ אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת עַד שֶׁיָּרוֹק.
segments.en: «Rabbi Yehuda says: Even once» a person’s «spittle is gathered in his mouth, he» may «not walk four cubits» in the public domain «until he spits» it out, for he would be carrying the accumulated spittle in his mouth, which is akin to carrying any other object.
